Hi Camila — thanks for the summary, that was helpful. A few quick answers and follow-ups from procurement side:

- Marketplace: we prefer AWS Marketplace if possible (most of our infra is on AWS).
- Payment: procurement typically requires a PO for anything over $10k/year; corporate card is usually only for one-off smaller purchases.
- Timeline: procurement review + legal sign-off is typically 3–4 weeks if standard terms; SOC 2 evidence will be requested.

Can you confirm: if we go via AWS Marketplace, can LumenAI still get a contract (SOW) with Redwood, or is it strictly an AWS purchase? Also are there discounts for committing to dedicated capacity / reserved hours?

Looping in procurement — procurement@lumenai.com, could you please confirm required docs and preferred next steps?

Got it. Quick notes:

- AWS Marketplace: We support AWS Marketplace (SaaS and Metering). Customers can buy via Marketplace and still sign an SOW with us for implementation; the commercial purchase will be processed through AWS but we can have a separate services SOW signed (DocuSign).
- Timing: AWS vendor onboarding typically 2–4 weeks (depends on tax forms & contract review). If LumenAI needs to use PO via Marketplace, many customers procure through AWS using a PO routed through their internal process — confirm with AWS Marketplace team.
- Pricing / discounts: We have standard reserved capacity tiers (3-month, 12-month, committed) — I’ll attach the pricing primer and onboarding checklist you can share. For pilots under ~$50k ARR we typically recommend starting with a SaaS listing to speed procurement, then convert to Dedicated reserved capacity if/when commit grows.

Actions:
1) Share the attached pricing PDF and onboarding checklist (already attached in thread) with procurement.
2) If they want a services SOW, use the attached sow-lumenai-draft.docx and I’ll review redlines.
3) If they prefer Marketplace, CC the AWS Marketplace contact (marketplace@amazon.com) and I’ll open a vendor onboarding ticket from our side to accelerate verification.

Attachments included: [Attachment: redwood-marketplace-pricing.pdf], [Attachment: marketplace-onboarding-checklist.pdf], [Attachment: sow-lumenai-draft.docx]

If you want, I can hop on a quick 15-min call with procurement next week to walk through timelines — let me know availability and I’ll book.
